ai_summary: Arisinfra Solutions is increasing its ownership in its high-growth subsidiary, Buildmex-Infra, from 76% to 92% for ₹60 crore, aiming to capture more value from the subsidiary's impressive ~10x revenue growth over the past two years. This strategic acquisition is structured to avoid impacting Arisinfra's overall cash position, as the consideration will be offset by a corresponding reduction in trade deposits and advances, indicating a non-cash or asset-neutral transaction.
